angle_gap: Report treats flexible/hybrid working as a broad workplace-policy topic; the recruiting-relevant finding (61% of employers say advertising flexibility matters for attracting talent amid labour shortages, and hybrid lets them recruit from a wider UK geography) is one buried bullet with no breakdown of which roles or industries benefit most, or how to act on it in job ads and screening.
